body: Moved. On a desktop, full screen is now an icon at the end of the tool bar, right after undo and redo: four corners pushed out to the edges. It shows in every desktop tool bar layout, and the word is gone from the bottom line. F still works. A phone keeps the word in its bottom line, because its tool bar has no room; say if you want it there too. The change is in `apps/web/src/components/UndoRedo.tsx`, and there's an after picture in this thread. Ready to check.
